Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The Windies players have taken the field. Lauren Winfield and Tammy Beaumont are the openers for England Women. Shamilia Connell to start with the ball..
... The Chase...

Right then! 226 runs for the defending champions to open their account in this edition. The spinners are getting grip while the pacers are enjoying the early swing. So England Women have to watch out for it. West Indies Women have some momentum with them and would try to make use of it. This should be a cracker of a chase. Stay tuned as the chase is coming up shortly...

Sophie Ecclestone (10-4-20-3) comes up for a quick word. Says that the conditions offered some bounce and it's a good wicket. Adds that finding her length and pace was the key. Admits that they didn't have their best day on the field. She is backing her batting unit to chase down the target and suggests that the batters need to go hard and sweep hard on this surface.

It was a see-saw innings for West Indies Women. Both the openers got lives early on with Hayley Matthews seeing herself lucky twice. The duo made most of it until Powerplay 1 was over. They succumbed to the pressure in the middle phase and the 21st over changed the complexion of the game. Struggling at  98 for 4, Chedean Nation and Shemaine Campbelle started the repair work and although runs came at a slow rate, they slowly build the innings and kept the scoreboard ticking. 123 runs were added by the duo and that will give some boost to West Indies Women.

An excellent turnaround from England Women. At first, it was looking like it will be a hard day at the office for them after three dropped catches and a missed stumping. The game turned on its head as they came back superbly in the 21st over of Sophie Ecclestone - two wickets and a run out saw the English side claw its way back. After Powerplay 1, England kept piling the pressure and they got rewards for it. Although, 123 runs were added by Nation and Campbelle, which England allowed as there were many chances missed to get rid of them. Sophie Ecclestone was the pick of the bowler as she took three wickets while giving away just 20 runs, including four maidens as well. Other bowlers were handy as well. Overall, leaving the fielding away, it was a good performance from the defending champions.

So, 47 coming off the last five overs. West Indies Women started and ended the innings on a high, it was just their middle phase that did not help them very much. England Women were very sloppy on the field, dropping as many as 7 catches. Fair to say, they were very poor on the fielding side today.
Back of a length, outside off, Nation cracks it to deep point but gets only a single. She stays on 49 and West Indies Women finish on 225/6!

Run out chance, missed! Too full in length, around leg, Aaliyah Alleyne swings her bat at it but misses. The keeper also fails to collect cleanly. They cross for a bye as Amy Jones misses her shy at the bowler's end.
Short in length and around off, Nation steps back and slaps it to sweeper cover for one. Moves to 48!
Aaliyah Alleyne walks in next.

OUT! Run out! Full and on middle, Henry forces it back to the bowler and looks for an impossible single. Anya Shrubsole collects the ball, turns and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end. Chinelle Henry tries to dive in but has failed to reach the crease. The replays confirm the same.
Appeal for a run out...
Outside off, Henry swings her bat at it and misses.
Too full and outside off, Nation squeezes it out to point for a run.
Chinelle Henry is in next.

OUT! Clattered! A full toss, around middle and leg, Shemaine Campbelle swings her bat at it, loses her shape as she tries to go over the leg side. Fails to connect and the stumps are shattered. End of a very important knock from Shemaine Campbelle and her stand with Chedean Nation has bailed out West Indies Women somewhat.
FOUR! Sliding down the leg side, on a good length, Shemaine Campbelle goes down to sweep but it takes the top half and scoots down to fine leg for a boundary. These runs count.
A low full toss around leg, Campbelle flicks it off the inner half to deep backward square leg for another couple.
A high full toss wide outside off, Shemaine slaps it to deep point for a couple. Called a no ball for being over the waist. Free Hit coming up...
Slower one, full and on off, driven down to mid off for a run.
Angling down the leg side, Shemaine clips it wide of short fine leg for a run.
DROPPED! Butter fingers again. Fuller and on middle, Shemaine Campbelle tries to heave but gets a leading edge. Anya Shrubsole settles underneath it at short third man but drops a sitter. Two taken.

FOUR! Shot! Too full in length and around off, Nation drills her drive through the line and beats the fielder inside the ring at extra cover. No chance for the fielder in the deep and West Indies Women are getting a few boundaries at the backend of the innings.
Around off, on a length, Nation steps back to make room and slaps it through point. Two runs.
Slower one, full and around off, Shemaine advances down the track and drags her attempted heave over the leg side. It goes to deep mid-wicket for just a run.
Pitches it up and outside off, Nation drives it through cover-point for a run.
On a length around middle, turned in front of square leg for one. 200 up!
Back of a length, around off, Shemaine forces it down to mid off for a run. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end and the ball deflects away. They steal another run. The 100-run stand comes up.
Outside off, on a good length, played down softly to short third man for a run.

FIFTY FOR CAMPBELLE! Fullish and around leg, Shemaine Campbelle clips it to deep mid-wicket and attempts for the second run. Danni Wyatt sends a flat throw to the bowler who fails to collect it as Chedean Nation dives in. The replays show that England Women have missed out on a run out chance.
Fuller and on off, driven back past the bowler for a single.
Fuller and on off, angling in, Shemaine tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It loops in the air but falls safely on the leg side. They cross.
FOUR! Shot! Sciver bangs it in, short and on middle, Shemaine Campbelle rides the bounce and hammer-pulls it behind square leg for a cracking boundary.
Fuller and around off, whipped down to wide long on for a couple of runs.

EDGY FOUR! West Indies Women won't mind how they come, as long as they come. In the channel outside off, short in length, Nation flashes her bat at it and gets a thick outside edge down to third man for a boundary.
Short and wide, hit to point. The fielder fumbled and a run was taken.
Back of a length, around off, guided to point for one. With 6 wickets in the bank, West Indies Women should look for some attacking shots.
Slower one, full and around off, Shemaine drops it with gentle hands to covers for a quick run.
Slightly short and around off, it's eased towards point for a run.
Starts with a short ball wide outside off, Nation tries to cut but misses.
Anya Shrubsole is back on to bowl at the death. 0/35 in her 5 overs so far.
A low full toss on leg, Nation knocks it down to long on for a run.
Two wides! Angling down the leg side, on a length, the batter fails to flick and Amy Jones also fails to collect. They cross.
Forces a length ball through covers for a single.

FOUR! A much-needed boundary for West Indies Women. Natalie Sciver offers some room outside off, short in length, Chedean Nation whacks it through the line and picks the gap between short third man and backward point.
Width outside off, short in length, whacked to deep cover for one.
Helps a length ball in the gap at mid-wicket for a single.

Run out chance, missed! This one is delivered on a good length around off, Shemaine Campbelle helps it towards mid-wicket and they cross for a hesitant single. Danni Wyatt attacks the ball and throws it to the keeper who breaks the stumps without collecting the ball. Chedean Nation gets a life.
Short and on off, Shemaine slaps it to deep cover for one. Kate Cross is done with her spell, 10-1-36-0.

Uppish and it might have just carried. On a length and outside off, Chedean Nation slashes hard at it and it goes off the outer edge to short third man. Anya Shrubsole goes down low but fails to take the catch. It did carry. They cross for a run.
Misses out! Short and wide outside off, Shemaine blazes her cut shot to point where Tammy Beaumont makes a partial stop. Only a single.
Slower one, full and around leg, Nation flicks it aerially in front of square leg for a run.
Around off, on a length, Shemaine works it to the right of mid-wicket for a quick run.
Angles in a length ball on off, it's defended back to the bowler.
Short in length, outside off, Chedean Nation drags her pull shot behind mid on and collects a couple.
Uses the angle of the bowler and works a length ball to mid-wicket for a single.
Presses forward to a full ball and drives it through cover-point for a run.
Short in length and outside off, Shemaine Campbelle pulls it to deep mid-wicket and two is on. However, Chedean Nation slips while turning for the second run. Only a run.
Gets forward and pushes it to covers for a single.
Starts with a full ball on the pads, it's worked to mid-wicket.
Change in bowling. Natalie Sciver returns. 4-1-8-0 are her figures so far.
Slower one, full and close to off, it's defended near the front pad. Just 2 from the over.
Lands it fuller and close to off, Shemaine Campbelle drives but finds mid off.
Full and angling in, helped to mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, played down wide of short third man for one.
Outside off, tapped down to point.
Sliding down the leg side, tucked behind square leg for a run.
Quicker and fuller on off, defended back. Sophie Ecclestone is done with her spell of 10 overs - 3 for 20 along with 4 maidens. Brilliant comeback after a sorry outing against Australia Women.
Flighted and outside off, pushed with an angled bat to point.
Flatter arm ball around leg, Chedean Nation fails to work it around and is hit high on her back leg.
Short and on off, cut to deep cover for one.
Full and outside off, pushed down to mid off.
Skidding down the leg side, flicked in front of square leg for a single.
Fuller and on off, driven to point for a run.
Full and on middle, Nation pushes it straight back to the non-striker's stumps. Cross gets a hand on it but Campbelle did well to stride her foot back inside the crease.
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this inning.
Another one angling down the leg side. Nation misses her flick. This time Jones collects and appeals for caught behind but nothing from the umpire. A wide given as well.
Fuller and on middle. Campbelle punches it to mid on and takes a quick single.
Length and on off. Hit to covers for a single.

NOT OUT! A length ball, drifting down the leg side. Nation looks to flick but misses. She loses her footing and had to turn around quickly. Jones, behind the sticks, is quick to notice that as she removes the bails off. She appeals. It's referred. The replay shows Nation had her foot down when the bails were dislodged and NOT OUT is the answer. Also, wide has been signalled. The 50-run stand comes up as well.
Shout for a stumping! It has been referred upstairs...
Fuller and on middle, pushed down the ground but the mid on fielder cuts it out.
A length ball, outside off. Nation punches it to the left of point and the fielder dives to that side to stop it.
Tossed up, outside off, it lands and spins away sharply. Campbelle looks to drive but gets beaten by the spin.
Fuller ball, floated and outside off. Campbelle swings across the line and misses.
Short and outside off. Nation slaps it to deep point for one.
On middle. Campbelle wrists it to square leg and takes a quick single. Good running there.
FIVE WIDES! Rare loosener from Sophie Ecclestone! Quicker ball, down the leg side. Tough for the keeper to collect and West Indies get a free boundary.
A single as this is driven through covers.
Fuller ball, on middle. Campbelle uses her feet and whips it to mid-wicket where the fielder half-stops and a single is stolen.
Length ball, on off. Campbelle taps it to covers and takes a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Fuller again. Campbelle lifts it over mid on and the fielder chases it and keeps it down to two.
Fuller and on middle, played back to the bowler.
A length ball, jagging back in and on middle. Campbelle looks to defend but gets beaten on the inside edge and gets hit on the pads. A half-hearted appeal follows for LBW.
Fuller again, around off. Campbelle works it to point. Dot balls piling up here.
A fuller ball, around off. Campbelle lunges and pushes it to covers.
Change! Heather Knight takes herself out of the attack and brings Kate Cross on. 0/21 in her 6 overs so far.
A quick full ball, around off and Nation gets her bat down in time to defend it. 4th maiden for Sophie Ecclestone.
Tossed up, outside off. Nation hits it to point. Can't find the gap.
Fuller ball, outside off, pushed to mid off this time.
An arm ball, outside off. Nation knocks it to point.
Shorter and outside off, Nation cuts it but finds the fielder again.
Flatter, quicker and outside off. Nation cuts it to point.
Bowling change. Sophie Ecclestone (7-3-9-3) is back into the attack.
A full toss, dipping onto the right-hander. Campbelle pushes it to covers. She missed out on the freebie there.
Flatter ball, outside off. Nation punches off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
This time she hits it through the gap, to point and collects a single.
Full ball again, outside off. Campbelle guides it to backward point.
Full ball, way outside off, driven to deep point for a single.
A full toss, on middle and leg. Nation tries to sweep but gets a bottom edge and the ball ricochets on her pads.
Full ball, on middle. Campbelle defends it out.
A quick bouncer, outside off. Campbelle attempts to hook it but pulls her bat out ultimately. Another good take by Amy Jones.
Two wides! A length ball, down the leg side. The keeper fumbles to stop it and the batters take a single as well.
Fuller and on middle, Nation turns it to mid-wicket. Straight to the fielder there.
On a length, outside off. Campbelle plays it to deep backward point for a single.
Angles it on the hips. Campbelle tickles it to fine leg and bags a brace.
A length ball, nipping back in, around middle and leg. Shemaine Campbelle looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW but there was a thick inside edge.
A single to end the over as this is eased down to long on.
Around off, Nation works it to sweeper cover for a single.
A fuller ball, outside off. Shemaine gets an outside edge as she looks to push and scampers across to complete the single as the ball rolls to short third man.
Slower and on middle, Nation turns it to square leg for a single.
Very full, flighted and outside off. Nation looks to drive but misses it.
Fuller ball, outside off. Shemaine Campbelle comes down the track and drills it to long on for a single.
Fullish delivery, on middle, pushed to mid on. 9 runs off the over.
On the pads, this is hit to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller and on off, pushed back to Brunt.

FIVE WIDES! First time Amy Jones missed out behind the stumps but this was pretty hard as that was going with the angle way down the leg side. Shemaine Campbelle missed her flick and it raced away to the fine leg fence.
A yorker, in the slot. Nation does well to squeeze it out to square leg and she gets a single.
Wide! Slightly short and drifting down the leg side. Nation misses her pull.
Length again, on middle. Shemaine is hurried as she pulls it to the fine leg region. A single taken.
On a length, on off. Shemaine hops and blocks it out.
A floated ball, on middle, Nation pushes it softly to covers.
Fuller and outside off. Nation drops it to point.
Follows the boundary with a single as this is eased to long on.

FOUR! Welcome boundary! Good intent is shown there by Shemaine Campbelle! Fuller and on middle. Shemaine Campbelle skips down the track and powers it through mid-wicket for a boundary. First boundary for West Indies Women after the 22nd over.
Tossed up, outside off. Nation steps across and defends in front of covers for a quick single.
A floated ball, full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.

Drinks break. This match has turned on its head. West Indies Women raced away to a great start but England Women have pulled things back exceptionally well by picking wickets. The pair of Sophie Ecclestone and Kate Cross helped them in drying up the runs and that resulted in the first breakthrough. After that, it was a mini-collapse for the Caribbean team and now they are struggling to find the momentum back. Heather Knight to bowl after the break...
Fuller and on middle. Campbelle lunges and defends it out.
On a length, an off-cutter as this one comes back in and Campbelle bunts it on the leg side.
Short of a length, on middle. Nation pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
A yorker now, on middle. All Nation can do is to defend it out.
A length ball, outside off. Nation taps it to point.
A full ball, on middle. Shemaine Campbelle tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Katherine Brunt is back on. 0/22 from her 4 overs so far.
Fuller and on middle, Nation strides forward and drives it back to the bowler.
Floated and full, around off, defended back.
Around off, played down in front of backward point for a brisk run.
Full and on off, driven again to mid off.
Flatter and on middle, swept firmly to deep square leg for a run.
Loopy and full, around off, it's driven down to mid off.
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it to point for a single. 7-3-9-3, exceptional figures from Sophie so far.
Oohhh...that was very close to the off pole. Scrambled seam, an arm ball pushed quicker through the air, it's around off and Nation offered no shot.
Fuller and flatter around leg, once again Nation fails to beat mid on.
Eases a full ball down the ground, finds mid on.
Appeal for an lbw, the umpire shakes her head. An arm ball,  around middle and leg, Nation fails to flick and is hit on the pads. Going down.
Gets on the front foot and drives it through the tiny gap at covers for a couple of runs.
Around off, Shemaine Campbelle again plays the on drive but finds the fielder inside the ring.
Fuller and on middle, knocked down to mid on.
Drifting in around off, full in length, Nation tries to defend but edges it down towards short third man for one. 100 up!
Fuller and on off, pushed firmly to covers.
Fuller and around off, it's nudged away to short third man for a quick run.
Flighted and on off, Shemaine Campbelle defends it back to the bowler.
Lunges and defends a full ball to covers. A wicket maiden!
Full and around off, turning away, Nation tries to defend but gets beaten.
Gets forward and pushes it out to mid on.
Turn and bounce around off, Chedean Nation pushes at it and misses.
Fuller and on off, defended to covers.
Chedean Nation is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sharp catch by Danni Wyatt as that ball was travelling at the speed of light. It's an absolute screamer. Tossed up, full and outside off, Kycia Knight advances down the track and tries to hammer it through the line. She fails to keep it down and Danni Wyatt at covers reacts quickly to catch it near her chest. The pace on the ball forces her back and she goes down too but does well to hold on to the catch. England's catching has improved exceptionally of late.
Commentary.Howout: c Danni Wyatt b Sophie Ecclestone

Commentary.Commentary: NOT OUT! The impact is outside off. Slower through the air, full and flighted around off, it lands and turns in a shade, Shemaine Campbelle goes down to sweep but misses and is pinged on the back pad. They appeal and the finger goes up. Shemaine Campbelle uses the DRS to get the onfield decision overturned.
Shout for an lbw, the finger has gone up! Shemaine Campbelle takes the referral...
Fullish again, around middle, it's tickled to square leg for one.
Fullish and around middle, Knight goes down and dinks it to fine leg for two.
Walks forward to a full ball but drives it straight to mid off.
Drifting in from around off, fuller in length, Kycia Knight defends off the front foot.
Fuller and outside off, Kycia drives it to covers.
Too full and on middle, it's jammed back to the bowler. Sophie Ecclestone continues to bowl tidily.
Around off, some extra bounce, Knight goes back to defend but misses. It clips her thigh pad and rolls towards short third man for a leg bye.

Aerial but safe! Loopy and full, around off and turning in, Kycia Knight advances down the track and drags her attempted heave shot over wide mid on. Two taken. The umpire checks upstairs for one short run and the replays find that Knight didn't drag the bat inside the crease while completing the first run.
Tossed up, full and on off, defended back to the bowler.
Flighted and on middle, swept to fine leg for one.
Flatter and on off, defended off the back foot.
Prods forward to a full ball and dead-bats it near the surface on the off side.
Loopy and full, around off, Kycia Knight presses forward and defends it from the inner half of her bat.
Tossed up, around off, Shemaine Campbelle drops it with gentle hands to cover-point and steals a single.
Flighted and on off, blocked off the front foot.
Walks forward and looks to drive but ends up slicing it to short third man.
Flighted and around off, defended to covers.
Heather Knight brings herself into the attack.
Flatter and quicker on off, defended from the back foot to the leg side.
Loopy and full, around off, Campbelle drives it to mid off and a misfield allows a single.
Slip in place now.
Leans forward to a full ball and eases it behind square leg for a run.
Fuller and on middle, forced down to mid on.
Full and floated on off, defended.
Flighted and on off, some extra bounce, Kycia Knight defends it from the splice of her bat.
FOUR! First loose ball from Cross in her spell and it's put away. A low full toss on the pads, Shemaine Campbelle tucks it over square leg and gets a boundary. Opens her account.
Presses forward to a full ball and blocks.
On a length and outside off, left alone.
Fuller and on middle, worked through square leg for a single.
Fuller and on off, defended off the front foot.
Wide again! Sliding down the leg side, Knight leaves.
Wide! Cross changes her angle but again slips one down the leg side, Knight allows it through.
Gets forward and defends it back.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, Knight leaves.
Shemaine Campbelle walks in next. A slip in place.
Tossed up, around off, defended off the front foot. End of an exceptional over, 3 wickets in it!

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! What's happening, West Indies Women have pressed the panic button. The Big 3 of the West Indian batting are back in the pavilion in the same over. Talk about making a roaring comeback! England Women are the defending champions for a reason. Flighted ball, around off and turning away, Stafanie Taylor tries to defend but gets a faint outside edge behind. Amy Jones swiftly takes the catch, they appeal and the finger has gone up. The whole complexion of this match has changed. The replays, later on, show that it took the gloves of the West Indian skipper.
Commentary.Howout: c Amy Jones b Sophie Ecclestone

Commentary.Commentary: Stafanie Taylor walks in next.

OUT! RUN OUT! So, after being clumsy in the field, England Women have risen from the ashes. Great piece of fielding by Danni Wyatt and both the set batters are sent back in the same over. Floated and full, outside off, Kycia Knight pushes it with gentle hands to covers and looks for a run. Deandra Dottin responds but fails to make it safely as Danni Wyatt comes up with a direct hit at the striker's end. Dottin is well short!
Loopy and around off, Kycia defends it off the front foot.
Flighted and on off, defended off the front foot.
Kycia Knight is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! Stop the press. After three failed attempts, England Women have finally taken a catch. Some great economical bowling since Powerplay 1 from the defending champions built pressure on the West Indian batters and Hayley Matthews falls in an attempt to break the shackles. It's on a fuller length and around off, Matthews tries for a lofted shot over covers but ends up slicing it towards backward point. Anya Shrubsole goes down low to secure the catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Anya Shrubsole b Sophie Ecclestone

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, pushed to mid-wicket.
Make it five! A length ball, outside off. Dottin has a poke at it but misses. Deandra Dottin, one run off last 19 deliveries.
Length ball, around off. Dottin with soft hands, on the deck. Four dots in a row.
On a length, outside off. Dottin pushes it aerially but well short of the fielder at covers.
Length again, outside off. Dottin knocks it to the left of extra cover. Good stop there.
A length ball, outside off, it is hit to covers.
Slightly short and outside off. Hayley Matthews pushes off the back foot, to mid-wicket. Another good over from the English side. They are gaining some control in the middle overs.
Flatter and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
A full ball, on off. Dottin heaves it to long on for a single. Mistimed her shot.
Fuller now, flicked to mid-wicket.
Floated, on middle. Defended with soft hands on the leg side.
Flatter and on middle. Hayley Matthews stays back and flicks it to square leg for a run.
Length and on middle. Dottin keeps it out. Good over from Kate Cross, just a single off it.
Short of a length, outside off. Dottin tries to cut it over point but bottom-edges it to cover. Not happy with herself there.
Outside off, fuller, driven nicely but straight to covers.
A full ball, coming with the angle, on the pads. Dottin gets on her knee and tries to slog-sweep but fails to get any bat there.
Around off, pushed to covers.
A length ball, angling on the pads. Hayley Matthews whacks it to mid-wicket. Another sloppy fielding as the fielder lets it through her hands and allows a single.
Kate Cross to continue from the other end...
Full and flighted, around middle, defended back off the front foot. Maiden!
Played towards mid off.
Fuller and on off, defended.
Tossed up, around off. Dottin gets her bat down to block it out.
Now presses forward and defends this full ball on the surface.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Dottin punches off the back foot, to point.

Drinks break. Controlled aggression shown by West Indies Women and they have put themselves in a great position after the first 16 overs. The English Women have been very untidy in the field, dropping as many as three catches and are under the pump. Deandra Dottin was dropped on the first ball of the game and then Hayley Matthews received two lives. Both are looking set and can punish the defending champions. The runs have dried up after Powerplay 1 but it's just a matter of time before one of the two set batters can take on the attack. Sophie Ecclestone is introduced into the attack after the break. She is the leading wicket-taker between overs 11-40 since the last Women's World Cup.
On a length, on middle. Hayley Matthews pushes it gently to mid-wicket.
A length ball, outside off. Hayley Matthews tries to work it on the leg side and gets a leading edge, just short of the fielder at covers. Played too early there.
Fuller in length around middle, Hayley flicks it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Full in length, around off, Hayley plays it off her pads to mid-wicket. Not in the gap.
Uses the angle of the bowler and helps it towards mid-wicket for a brisk single.
A length ball, outside off, it skids through and Dottin looks to defend inside the line and gets beaten on the outside edge.
On the pads, flicked straight to the fielder at mid-wicket again. Boundaries have dried up in the last five overs.
Length and outside off. Hayley punches it to mid-wicket.
A length ball, angling around leg. Hayley Matthews misses her flick and gets hit on the pads.
A bouncer, outside off. Dottin slaps it aerially and to deep cover for a single.
Around off, tucked through mid-wicket for one run.
A length ball, on middle, Dottin tucks it to square leg and takes off for a quick single. The fielder there has a shy at the keeper's end but the batter was well in with a big dive.
Full ball, outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Wide! Cross serves it down the leg side, on a length and Dottin misses her flick. Amy Jones has been really clean with her glovework so far.
Fuller ball, around off. Dottin drives it off the outer half of the blade to covers.
Around off, on a length. A single as this is hit to deep mid-wicket.
A length ball, outside off, a hint of inward shape. Dottin swings across and manages an inside edge to deep square leg for a single.
On middle. Defended out.
A fuller ball, outside off. Hayley Matthews tries to push but gets an outside edge to third man for one more. Luck favouring West Indies Women today.
On a length, on middle. Dottin bunts it to mid-wicket. Natalie Sciver has been very tidy.
Full ball, on off, pushed to mid off.
Length and on off, played back to the bowler.
A short ball by Sciver, around middle and leg. Dottin misses her pull shot The keeper, who is standing up, shows good reflexes as she collects it.
Fuller ball, angling in from around off. Hayley Matthews tucks it to square leg where a misfield allows a single. Although the outfield is wet, the fielding is very below-par today.
Length ball, outside off. Dottin hits it to deep cover for a single.
Length and on off, nudged to mid-wicket.
A length ball, outside off. Hayley Matthews guides it to the left of point where the fielder puts a dive to stop it. Good fielding.
SIX! BANG! A fuller ball, on middle, Hayley Matthews smashes straight down the ground for a maximum.
Length ball, on middle. Blocked out.

Dropped! Yet again, another chance goes begging. On a length, on middle. Hayley Matthews shows her full face of the bat and defends it uppishly, back to the bowler. Kate Cross tries to take it on her right side but fails to hold on. Another easy catch that England fail to take.
A length ball, on middle. Hayley Matthews keeps it out to mid-wicket.
Change in bowling. Kate Cross is introduced into the attack.
Length and outside off, Hayley Matthews wrists it to deep square leg for one.
Angling on the pads. Hayley Matthews misses her flick and gets hit on the pads. Was going down the leg side.
Fuller again, on off. Hayley Matthews blocks it on the front foot.
A full ball, angling on middle, this is drilled to long on for a single.
Length and outside off. Defended off the back foot.
A length ball, around off. Hayley Matthews shuffles across and tucks it to square leg for a single.
End of Powerplay 1! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders are allowed outside the inner circle for the bowling side till the 40th over.

FOUR! What a way to end the first 10 overs! Anya serves it on a length and outside off, Dottin bends her back knee, latches onto the width and smashes it behind the bowler for a boundary. At the end of Powerplay 1, West Indies Women have raced to 58/0!
Fuller and outside off, Hayley Matthews drives it towards cover-point where the fielder dives and takes the pace off the ball. Only a single this time.
FOUR! Hayley is dealing in boundaries. Fuller and around off, slower in pace this time, Matthews again takes the aerial route and smacks it over mid on for a boundary.
On a length, around off and angling in, Hayley Matthews hangs back and defends it to mid on.
SIX! Dismissed! Full and around off, right in the slot for the batter, Hayley Matthews launches onto it and dismisses it over long on for a maximum.
Around middle, on a length, Matthews defends it towards mid on.
Maiden! Full and on off, Dottin is on the front foot as she offers a dead bat in defense.
Five dots now, something is brewing! On a length and outside off, defended to the off side.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller and around off, Dottin gets forward and offers a textbook defensive shot.
Angling down the leg side, on a length again, Deandra Dottin tries to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
In the channel around off, on a length and shaping in, Deandra Dottin defends it to covers.
FOUR! Beautiful shot to spoil what could have been a maiden! Short in length and outside off, Hayley Matthews hangs on the back foot and strokes it through the gap at covers for a boundary.

Uppish but safe! Again there is some movement off the surface and it holds up a bit too after landing on a length around off. Hayley Matthews checks her drive, the bottom hand comes off and it goes aerially but safely towards the cover region.
Full and on off, shaping in, Hayley is watchful as she draws forward in defense.
Lands it on a length and around off, it's forced off the front foot to covers.
Pitches it up and outside off, Hayley gets forward to drive but it takes the inside edge and ricochets off her front boot to covers.
Slightly short and outside off, moving back in a shade off the seam, Hayley Matthews defends it from the back foot.
Fullish and on off, shaping in, Dottin defends it back to the bowler.
Short and on off, Dottin punches from the back foot but finds the fielder at covers.
Wide! A bouncer but down the leg side, Deandra Dottin tries to pull but misses. It's a steady drizzle at the moment and that will make the ball skid on nicely onto the bat.
Sliding into the batter, around leg, Hayley Matthews fails to flick and it goes off her pads to square leg. They cross for a leg bye.
FOUR! Touch and class! Back of a length, around off, Hayley Matthews hangs back to get on top of the bounce and punches it delightfully through the gap between point and cover-point.
Fuller in length around middle, Matthews flicks but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
FOUR! Bang! Katherine Brunt is on the shorter side with her length, it's around off, Hayley Matthews sits on the back foot, rides the bounce and clubs it to the deep square leg fence.
A touch short and angling down the leg side, Deandra Dottin nudges it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Fuller and on middle, it's worked to deep mid-wicket for a single.

DROPPED! And again, a chance has gone down in the field. Fuller and around off, swinging in, Hayley Matthews tries to heave it over the leg side but it takes the leading edge. It flies behind Tammy Beaumont at point, she runs back but fails to hold on. So, both the openers have got a life each. Two more added to the total.
Lands it on a length around off, shaping in, Hayley Matthews defends it watchfully from the back foot.
Not from the middle of the bat! Fuller and on middle, Dottin tries to flick but gets it away off the inner half to fine leg. A single taken.
Movement in the air and off the pitch as well. On a length and around off, Hayley Matthews clips it through square leg for a single.
Full and on middle, it is pushed to mid on.
Play and a miss! A length ball, angling on the pads. Dottin looks to heave it but misses and gets hit near the pads.
Length ball, on the pads. Dottin clips it to square leg. She wanted a single but was sent back quickly.
Short ball, on middle, Dottin looks to pull but gets a top edge towards the fine leg region. A couple of runs taken.
A little bit of drizzle in the air now...

FOUR! Pulled away! Short of a length, on middle. Dottin waits and pulls it through square leg for a boundary. A no ball is given as Katherine Brunt knocked the stumps off in her delivery stride. Free Hit coming up...
On a length, outside off, a hint of away shape. Dottin hits it to covers. No run there.
Wide! A short ball, angling down the leg side with some movement, Deandra Dottin ducks.
A length ball, just outside off. Dottin defends with an angled bat, to covers.
A length ball, at 104 clicks, around off. Hayley Matthews knocks it to mid off. Just a single off the over.
Touch fuller, outside off. Hayley Matthews pushes it nicely but finds the fielder at mid off.
Anya Shrubsole gets the swing again, around off. It's pushed to mid on.
Touch short, drifting around off. Hayley Matthews presses forward as she blocks it out.
Length ball, on middle. Dottin tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
A length ball, inward movement there, on middle. Dottin keeps it out.
Sweeper out on the leg side after that one big shot from Deandra Dottin.
Fuller ball, straight on middle, Hayley Matthews flicks it to square leg and collects a couple of runs.
Length ball again, outside off. Hayley Matthews punches off the back foot, straight to the fielder at covers.
Length ball, outside off. Hayley Matthews mistimes her pull, straight to mid-wicket.
Length and on middle. Defended.
An outswinger, length and around off. Hayley Matthews defends with soft hands.
Length and on off. Hayley Matthews punches it past the bowler, to mid on.
SIX! It took no time for Deandra Dottin to show her skills. This was fuller, slanting around middle, Dottin powers it hard and over mid-wicket for a biggie.
On a length, on middle. Dottin blocks it on the leg side.
On middle, Hayley Matthews whips it to deep square leg for a single.
Dottin yet to settle in! A length ball, around off. Dottin looks to push but gets an outside edge, wide of first slip and to third man. A single taken.
This one comes with the angle, on the pads. Dottin again fails to read the ball and gets hit on the pads.
An inswinger, fuller and around off. Dottin flicks it through mid-wicket and towards mid on. No run there.
Anya Shrubsole to bowl from the opposite end.
A single to end the over! Length ball, outside off. Dottin guides it to third man for a single. A tidy start from Katherine Brunt, is unlucky not to have the wicket of Deandra Dottin.
Short of a length, slanting on the hips. Dottin, on the back foot, blocks it out.
Length again and Dottin watchfully defends it.
A length ball, around off. Hayley Matthews guides it wide of covers and takes a quick single. She is off the mark.
On a length, on off. Hayley Matthews taps it to point.

DROPPED! An easy miss! A fuller ball, angling on the pads and swinging away late. Deandra Dottin tries to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge, in the air and towards extra cover. Lauren Winfield, from mid off, runs to her left and forward but drops a regulation catch. The batters cross and West Indies Women are away. It was virtually the same dismissal for Deandra Dottin in the last match.

Right then, all in readiness now at the University Oval. Hayley Matthews and Deandra Dottin are the openers for West Indies Women.​ Katherine Brunt is getting ready to bowl the first over. The players take a knee against racism. Two slips in play. Here we go...

The players from both sides are marching out to the middle. It's time for national anthems. England's first, followed by the anthem of West Indies. Looking at the conditions, it's a bit strange that West Indies Women elected to bat first. There will be definitely something for the pace bowlers early on and the English Women will relish.

Pitch report - Cool and cloudy conditions but it's dry. Third game here and the same pitch is being used. It's devoid of grass and looks like a very good pitch for batting. Pace and bounce could have increased. As a bowler, you need to bowl a bit fuller to get anything from the pitch.

England Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Lauren Winfield, Tammy Beaumont, Heather Knight (C), Natalie Sciver, Amy Jones (WK), Danni Wyatt, Sophia Dunkley, Katherine Brunt, Sophie Ecclestone, Kate Cross, Anya Shrubsole.

West Indies Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Deandra Dottin, Hayley Matthews, Kycia Knight, Stafanie Taylor (C), Shemaine Campbelle (WK), Chedean Nation, Chinelle Henry, Aaliyah Alleyne, Shamilia Connell, Anisa Mohammed, Shakera Selman.

Heather Knight, the skipper of England Women, says they would have bowled first anyway. Adds, the pitch is a bit like it is in England, overcast as well. Tells, they have good experience in the bowling attack and mentions, it has been easier to chase. Adds, they didn't bowl to their standard in the previous match but she is not worried about it. Informs, they are going with the same XI.

Stafanie Taylor, the captain of West Indies Women, says that the pitch looks good and runs on the board will be helpful. Tells that it's a matter of learning from the mistakes and admits that they were not at their best in the field. Mentions that they have been under the radar and they want to play each game as the final. Informs that they have the same XI for this match.
TOSS - West Indies Women have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first!

West Indies Women with their win against New Zealand Women have sent a strong message to other teams and that win also speaks volumes about their never-say-die attitude. Onward and upward will be on top of their wishlist. England Women would be a bit disappointed after narrowly losing against Australia Women and losing such games often could be morale-deflating. That said there are many positives especially in their batting to take forward and they can be counted as favourites to prevail in this one. Toss and updates regarding the teams will be up in a short while...

Dunedin is back with its last game of this edition's ICC Women World Cup and it's going to be contested between England Women and West Indies Women. The defending champions will be eyeing an immediate comeback after suffering a close loss against arch-rivals in their tournament opener. The girls from the Caribbean Island, on the other hand, would be gung-ho after edging the host nation in a last-over thriller. This promises to be an absolute cracker as we welcome you all to the coverage. Stay tuned for more updates...
